quantcast: Exact matrix /pixel collectors on four pinned hosts are covered. Apple-vendor alias routing was exercised in Chromium by setting navigator.vendor, without claiming a native Safari execution. Other hosts and protocols are not inferred.

Producer state flags, random bounds, hash spellings, denied sentinels and GET/POST transport checks are advisory. Signed numeric revenue and empty or opaque first-party and session identities remain valid.
Arbitrary custom event properties remain open. Account ownership, digest correctness, consent decisions and delivery require external context. Existing core privacy checks remain active.
taboola-unip: Exact account-scoped /log/3/unip routes are covered. Publisher identity comes from the path and cannot be replaced by a query field. Other logger paths and S2S protocols remain separate.
Default event and subscription GET producers and explicit public TRCLogger POST form and Blob beacon methods were exercised separately. Logger POST controls do not imply default _tfa events use POST.

New clock, engagement, flag and HTTP checks are advisory. Custom event names and properties, opaque sd and literal null ref remain accepted. No unstated scroll ceiling, timestamp freshness or arbitrary property schema is inferred.
Account configuration, consent, conversion attribution and delivery require external context.
the-trade-desk: Exact legacy /track/up and current SDK /track/cei initialization routes are covered. Path-derived operation separates legacy required fields from advertiser-or-merchant initialization.
New initialization fields and rules are advisory. Pixel IDs, versions and configured metadata remain opaque. Realtime JSON and GET fallback conversions have separate packs.
Account ownership, identity permissions, cookie availability and delivery require external context.
the-trade-desk-conversions: The current SDK emits explicit null for unset data_processing_option. Both the parent and scoped root accept null; configured objects retain published policies and region requirements.

This follow-up changes only nullable processing-option compatibility. Other conversion receiver requirements and pre-existing review limits remain active. GET /track/rt does not inherit this JSON body schema.
Event attribution, permissions, deduplication and receiver delivery remain external.
the-trade-desk-realtime-fallback: Exact GET /track/rt on insight.adsrvr.org is a separate source-profile transport. It forwards scalar event fields and joins pixel_ids; nested object, item and privacy-array containers are omitted by the SDK and are not claimed here.

All fallback checks are advisory. Scalar value, currency, IP, advertising ID family, GUID spelling, RampID length, td1 through td10 length and fallback markers follow the pinned producer and documented scalar receiver definitions. RampID alphabet and custom event vocabularies are not inferred.
Fallback region is geographic context, distinct from the legacy pack processing-option region alias. GET capture bodies are not interpreted as CAPI events.
Account ownership, identity matching permissions, network success, conversion attribution and delivery require external context.

review_notes: Three unmodified vendor SDKs executed in Chromium with every collector request intercepted. All identities and page data are synthetic. No collector request reached an external service.
Quantcast signed revenue and The Trade Desk unset processing-option null were false errors in the previous engine. Explicit positive controls retain both cases.
The Apple host branch, source logger methods and forced fallback are identified separately from default producer behavior. No raw SDK sources are redistributed.
